title: Korean BBQ Beef Quesadillas
description: A fusion of Korean and Mexican flavors in a crispy quesadilla. Spicy Korean BBQ beef, gooey cheese, and crunchy stir-fried vegetables come together in this delicious and easy-to-make dish.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry vegetables (e.g., bell peppers, onions, carrots)

instructions: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, and Korean chili flakes.
Add the sliced beef to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in the skillet and cook the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Transfer the cooked beef to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add another tablespoon of oil and sauté the stir-fried vegetables for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the quesadillas by placing a few slices of beef and some stir-fried vegetables onto half of each tortilla, then topping with cheese.
Fold the tortillas in half and cook in the skillet for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve immediately.
